stemMd: The passage interprets Sela's route as

options.label: A
options.textMd: a description based solely on firsthand childhood observation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: a rejection of every documentary map.

options.label: C
options.textMd: proof that all childhood memories are false.

options.label: D
options.textMd: an organization of attachment and expectation that differs from navigable geography.

options.label: E
options.textMd: a deliberately accurate set of tourist directions.

explanationMd: The passage reframes apparent geographical error as an alternative organization of memory. The final paragraph distinguishes travel directions from modes of belonging, which is the main interpretive claim.

distractorRationale.c: The argument is about different forms of remembered geography.
distractorRationale.b: The printed plan helps make the poem's structure visible.
distractorRationale.e: The route cannot be followed on the plan.
